known_issues: The mod character is a name inserted into MODCHARACTERLIST for the duration of one case; no prefab is registered for it, which is enough for ValidateSpawnPrefabRequest and GetActiveCharacterList.
Filter checks compare the number of entries pairs() sees with the number ipairs() sees, so a filter with a gap fails even if every name is still stored somewhere in the table.

The default skin selection is exercised by calling GetSkinsList on a stand-in table that has the popup class as its metatable and a `character` field; no popup screen is constructed on the dedicated server.
The mod-skin build case names the entity's mod skin by setting `skinname`, as the library's SpawnPrefab does, instead of spawning a registered skin prefab.
